$comment: R549 runs retention. Terminal run records older than keepDays are archived (tar+zstd/gzip, verified read-back) to archiveDir/<YYYY-MM>/, then deleted. Overrides: WE_RUNS_RETENTION_KEEP_DAYS, _ARCHIVE_DIR, _MIN_FREE_GIB, _BATCH_MAX_GIB (uncompressed per batch; compressed must stay <= batchMaxCompressedGiB). Never writes to Forge.
